title: Quintessentially Smoky Indian Chickpeas Chana Masala
description: A smoky and crunchy Indian dish featuring chickpeas in a rich and flavorful tomato-based sauce, with a hint of pink food coloring and a touch of Kashmiri spices, all made possible by the tandoor cooking method and raw-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the onion until it is translucent.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the diced tomato and cook until it is soft and mushy.
Add the chickpeas, kashmiri red chili powder, garam masala, and tandoor spice mix, and stir well.
Add a splash of water to the pan and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the chana masala simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the pink food coloring and season with salt to taste.
Serve the smoky Indian chickpeas chana masala hot over rice or with naan bread.
